<style>
/* CloneWebX -> Elementor behavior fixes */
#faq button[aria-expanded="true"] + div {
  max-height: 520px !important;
}
#faq button[aria-expanded="true"] span[aria-hidden="true"],
.elementor-element-7702e5d3 button[aria-expanded="true"] span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.elementor-element-749b76b3.is-open {
  display: flex !important;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .elementor-element-55b15b79.is-visible {
    transform: translate(0px, 0px) !important;
  }
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  function ready(fn){
    if(document.readyState !== "loading"){ fn(); }
    else { document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn); }
  }

  ready(function(){
    /* Menu mobile */
    var drawer = document.querySelector(".elementor-element-749b76b3");
    var openBtn = document.querySelector(".elementor-element-33c406c2 .elementor-button, .elementor-element-33c406c2 a, .elementor-element-33c406c2 button");
    var closeBtn = document.querySelector(".elementor-element-47d60c03 .elementor-button, .elementor-element-47d60c03 a, .elementor-element-47d60c03 button");

    function openDrawer(e){
      if(e){ e.preventDefault(); }
      if(drawer){ drawer.classList.add("is-open"); drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false"); }
      if(openBtn){ openBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true"); }
    }

    function closeDrawer(e){
      if(e){ e.preventDefault(); }
      if(drawer){ drawer.classList.remove("is-open"); drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true"); }
      if(openBtn){ openBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); }
    }

    if(openBtn){ openBtn.addEventListener("click", openDrawer); }
    if(closeBtn){ closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeDrawer); }
    if(drawer){
      drawer.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(function(a){
        a.addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
      });
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
      if(e.key === "Escape"){ closeDrawer(); }
    });

    /* FAQ accordion */
    var faqButtons = document.querySelectorAll("#faq button[aria-expanded], .elementor-element-7702e5d3 button[aria-expanded]");
    faqButtons.forEach(function(btn){
      var panel = btn.nextElementSibling;
      if(!panel){ return; }

      panel.style.maxHeight = "0px";
      panel.style.overflow = "hidden";
      panel.style.transition = "max-height .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

      btn.addEventListener("click", function(e){
        e.preventDefault();

        var isOpen = btn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";

        faqButtons.forEach(function(other){
          var otherPanel = other.nextElementSibling;
          other.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          if(otherPanel){ otherPanel.style.maxHeight = "0px"; }
        });

        if(!isOpen){
          btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
          panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + "px";
        }
      });
    });

    /* CTA fixo mobile aparece depois da primeira dobra */
    var mobileCta = document.querySelector(".elementor-element-55b15b79");
    var hero = document.querySelector("#o-que-e, .elementor-element-49b17857");

    function showMobileCta(){
      if(!mobileCta){ return; }
      var shouldShow = true;
      if(hero){
        shouldShow = hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom < 80;
      }
      mobileCta.classList.toggle("is-visible", shouldShow);
    }

    showMobileCta();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", showMobileCta, {passive:true});
    window.addEventListener("resize", showMobileCta);
  });
})();
</script>
